In 1590, an English governor returned to Roanoke Island to find ninety colonists gone without a trace — no bodies, no graves, just one word carved into a post: CROATOAN. We rank all six leading theories from weakest to strongest, including the one the National Park Service still can't rule out.

This video uses AI narration and AI-generated illustrations.

Sources: National Park Service, Fort Raleigh National Historic Site — "Major Theories of the Lost Colony" (home.nps.gov/fora); NCpedia (North Carolina Government & Heritage Library) — "Virginia Dare and the Lost Colony: Fact and Legend"; History Hit — "The Mystery of the Lost Roanoke Colony".
